svg.title: From an agent to an audit: what each rung adds
svg.desc: Four rungs. Rung 0, an agent as it is: nothing is promised. Rung 1, the same agent as the one step of a workflow, adds the container, the record and the frame of the tool. Rung 2, fixed steps around the model, adds the path a workflow sets, measurements, checked evidence and gates. Rung 3, an audit with a register, adds findings across runs, decisions with who made them, and an end. The text under the drawing lists what each rung adds.
